lead_raw_text:
The structure of EuAlB crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell of 12 atoms (Eu4Al4B4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 9 neighbors (4 Al, 3 B, 2 Eu), B centers with a single B neighbor, and Eu centers with 16 neighbors (8 Al, 4 B, 4 Eu). The neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Al and Eu polyhedra.
